[Why]
* Clk Mgr DTO update point did not cover all needed updates
check for plane_state which does not exist yet when the updater is called on
driver startup
* This resulted in another update path in the pipe programming sequence
on a dppclk update flag
* However
column2: this alternate path allowed for stray DTO updates

column1: occur in the wrong order during dppclk lowering and cause underflow
[How]
* Remove plane_state check and use of plane_res.dpp->inst
of sequence dependencies (this results in extra dto programming for unused
pipes but that doesn't cause issues and is a small cost)
* Allow DTOs to be updated even if global clock is equal
edge case exposed by diags tests
* Remove update_dpp_dto call in pipe programming sequence (leave update to
dppclk_control there
column2: as that update is necessary and shouldn't occur in clk

column1: mgr)
* Remove call to optimize_bandwidth when committing state
